results.title: Two Former EDL Officials Sentenced to Life in USD 31.2 Million Corruption Case
results.content: The Vientiane Capital People’s Court has sentenced two former Électricité du Laos (EDL) officials to life imprisonment in a corruption case that caused more than USD 31.2 million in losses to the state, according to a court statement issued on 23 November.
